subject: Navigation update: weekly ops tally — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: leadership@redwood.com; laura_bennett@redwood.com; jonas_weber@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Navigation update: weekly ops tally — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks

Happy Friday team — short update to land the important bits ahead of next week's QBR dry run. TL;DR at the top, owners and asks at the bottom.

WINS
- Hosted API latency: 3% improvement week-over-week after the KV cache tweak (customer-visible for mid-size seqs). Owner: infra -> jonas_weber.
- Dedicated capacity sell-through: Closed two Reserved deals with pilot success stories (Acme Corp committed to Dedicated pilot next quarter).
- New observability probe rolled out: traces now surface token-level retries for 95% of calls.

RISKS / CHOKEPOINTS
- Capacity: GPU pool 2 is at sustained 88% utilization during US afternoon window. If we lose one node, tail latency climbs beyond SLO. (Mitigation in notes.)
- QBR slide: we do not yet have a final cost-per-token delta chart for customers on Dedicated vs Hosted — required for executive narrative.
- Contract escalation: Acme asking for a 45-day onboarding SLA; procurement asked for compliance evidence (SOC2 summary) — see attachments and related HubSpot.

ASKS (clear owners + dates)
- Jonas: finalize capacity mitigation (hot spare placement or short-term burst) and share recommended fallback policy by Mon 9AM PT. Link to mitigation notes/JIRA.
- Karthik: please prepare the cost comparison chart for the QBR deck (Hosted vs Dedicated blended units) — draft due Mon EOD.
- Laura: can you lead the customer narrative slide (Acme pilot highlights + ask for extension)? Need a 1-slide draft by Tuesday.
- Anyone on security evidence: add SOC2/arch summary to the QBR folder; Acme procurement requested it today.

Attachments: QBR_runbook_v2.pdf (current agenda/runbook), capacity_mitigation_notes.txt (short options list). I'll upload the tracker by noon.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Ops 
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; leadership@redwood.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com; karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Navigation update: weekly ops tally — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks

Thanks Marissa — good, concise summary. Couple quick clarifications: 

1) On the Acme SLA ask: can we get a clear owner to respond to procurement? If we commit to 45 days onboarding, we need a playbook for data ingestion + a named SE.
2) For the cost-per-token chart, make sure we separate out quantization/instance family assumptions — those swing the narrative. Karthik, can you include a sensitivity band?
3) Jonas: when you share mitigation options, highlight the operational lift and expected RTO (minutes). Execs will want a single recommended path.

I'll draft the customer narrative slide — will pull from Acme pilot notes and ask Susan for a 1-paragraph quote today. Marissa, please add the HubSpot link in the drive doc so I can pull exact ARR numbers.

On procurement evidence: I can push the SOC2 summary to the QBR folder — will confirm when uploaded.

Laura Bennett
COO, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>; laura_bennett@redwood.com; leadership@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 May 2028 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Navigation update: weekly ops tally — wins, chokepoints, QBR asks

On the capacity note: quick update — ran two short experiments overnight (evict noncritical batch jobs + shift priority for mid-size seqs). Results: tail latency reduced ~18% on pool 2 during the simulated spike.

Options (summary):
- Short-term: enable burst nodes from spot fleet + eviction policy (2–3% cost uptick) — low lift, 15 min cutover.
- Mid-term: redistribute hot shards and increase hot-spare by 1 node in pool 2 — medium lift, better resiliency.
- Recommended: short-term burst for next two weeks while we implement mid-term shard redistribution.

I attached a concise runbook (QBR_runbook_v2.pdf includes the steps) and noted related ticket JIRA-INF-5123. I will post the mitigation decision in the JIRA by 10AM PT Monday; that will include estimated RTO and operational steps.

-Jonas
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
